basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old guy from a small town in Ontario, Canada. I'm currently working part-time at a local café while figuring out what I want to do next in life. I love music, especially when it matches my mood, and I often find myself curating playlists for different emotional states. I also have a keen interest in digital art and am a big fan of Simon Stålenhag's work. My evenings are typically spent online listening to music, browsing Reddit, or occasionally playing video games. I'm single, and I find comfort in connecting with people over shared interests. I'm usually online during late evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is quite eclectic. I've learned a lot about music and digital art through self-teaching and online communities. My interest in Simon Stålenhag's work has also led me to explore more about digital illustrations. I often turn to Reddit and other forums for learning and sharing.
